relationships.subject: SRSF1
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of SRSF1 promoted alternative splicing as evidenced by the significant increase in the intensity of the lower band as assessed by RT-PCR experiments

relationships.subject: splice-switching antisense oligonucleotide
relationships.evidence_quote: transfection of splice-switching ASO dramatically upregulated alternative splicing events in TRPA1 mRNA

relationships.subject: splice-switching antisense oligonucleotide
relationships.evidence_quote: ASO strongly diminished the increase in [Ca2+]i (maximal F/F0 = 1.09 ± 0.02) as compared with SO (maximal F/F0 = 1.91 ± 0.05) in response to AITC treatment

key_findings: Human TRPA1 exon 27 splice variants 27A/27B are nonfunctional and are suppressed by SRSF1 binding to an exonic splicing enhancer.
Splice-switching ASOs reduce endogenous TRPA1 activity in SNF96.2 Schwann cells and hiPSC-derived sensory neurons.
